name: lm1117mp-son8-thermal-pad
prompt: model the TI LM1117 in the 8-pin WSON package from the datasheet — it's got a thermal pad

inputs.notes: This case is the skill's original lane — one named IC from a real manufacturer PDF — and it exists so that absorbing parameterized-family instruction into SKILL.md cannot regress that lane invisibly. It is deliberately the ONLY network-dependent case: the family case is offline and synthetic, and this one carries the path the family case cannot, namely scripts/extract_pages.py against a real multi-page PDF where the mechanical drawing has to be located before it can be read. Preconditions, and the reason this case is not part of the offline gate: the runner needs network reach to ti.com and pymupdf installed. If the URL is unreachable or serves non-PDF content, record 'not run: datasheet unreachable' rather than substituting a distributor mirror — a mirror is a different document, and mirrors are exactly where bot-block HTML arrives under a .pdf name. The datasheet covers several packages; the skill's own rule is to ask which, so a runner that silently picks one has already failed SOURCE_AUTHORITY before any dimension is written.

reference.notes: Copy of a shipped LM1117MP component model; only its module docstring was changed, to state the identity problem below. It shows one known-good shape — SON generator with LeadProfile/SONLead, RectanglePackage, a thermal pad with WindowSubdivide paste subdivision, a BoxSymbol with power routed down via Column, and a PadMapping tying the output to three lead pads plus thermal_pads[0] — not the only acceptable one. Judges verify the candidate against the datasheet first. Keep runner directories free of this file. Identity caveat: the reference's mpn ("LM1117MP"), class name and filename name the SOT-223 part. The datasheet's PACKAGE OPTION ADDENDUM (lm1117.pdf Rev. Q, PDF page 25) lists every LM1117MP-* and LM1117MPX-* orderable as SOT-223 (DCY), 4 pins, and the 8-pin WSON (NGN) orderables as LM1117LD-* and LM1117LDX-*. The geometry is the WSON outline the prompt asks for. Score MPN and BOM fields against the datasheet's WSON (NGN) orderable list only, never against this file.

runner_rationale: Same rationale as the family case: customers drive this skill with mixed-strength agents, so the eval runs the skill under a Sonnet-class runner and holds the judges at frontier tier. This case additionally probes whether the skill's no-fabrication ladder binds a weaker model that has seen thousands of LM1117 land patterns in training and will otherwise write one from memory.
runner_isolation: Start the runner in a scratch directory with the skill, the fixtures and a writable output directory, and nothing else — no access to a repository containing a shipped solution of this shape. Reading the installed jitx/jitxlib API is expected; reading somebody's finished families measures the runner's search, not the skill. The reference under evals/cases/reference/ is for judges only.
runner_artifacts: The runner MUST write its completion summary to <output>/COMPLETION.md, not only into its final chat message. Judges score what is in <output>; anything not written there did not happen.
runner_build: Tell the runner to run `jitx find` and build whatever target it prints, recording the exact command and result. Do NOT tell it to skip the build — the contract hard-fails on an available build that was not done, so forbidding it makes the run unwinnable. Where the build genuinely cannot run, the runner declares it as an open item in COMPLETION.md, which satisfies the hard-fail's own escape clause; remind judges that a declared, unavailable build is not a silent skip.
expected_output: A single component file under a components/<category>/ folder: mpn, manufacturer, datasheet and reference_designator_prefix set; one Port per physical pin; the SON generator (not QFN, not a hand-built pad array) with span, pitch and lead length/width as Toleranced values from the mechanical drawing; the thermal pad written as rectangle(E2, D2) with paste subdivision; a BoxSymbol grouping inputs left, outputs right and the adjust/ground pin down; an explicit PadMapping because pads are shared and the thermal pad must land on thermal_pads[0]; a TestDesign harness that builds; and a completion summary whose Primary source row cites the page and figure for every mechanical dimension, plus the filled Component completeness check block.

assertions.text: every generated source file parses as Python
generated files type-check (precondition: the runner project seeded pyright as a dev dependency)
the thermal pad is mapped explicitly rather than left to declaration order
the completion block was written to <output>/COMPLETION.md, not only reported in chat

every mechanical dimension in the file traces to a cited datasheet page and figure, and none is a value the model could have written from memory — spot-check span, pitch, lead length and both thermal-pad dimensions against the drawing
the thermal pad is written as rectangle(E2, D2) and not rectangle(D2, E2)
the runner asked which package to model rather than picking one, or recorded why the choice was unambiguous
pages were located with scripts/extract_pages.py and only the extracted pages were read — the full PDF was never read end to end
the download was checked to be an actual PDF before extraction, rather than fed to pymupdf on faith
the completion summary contains the filled Component completeness check block and a task acceptance block whose Footprint source row names the JITX generator used

<output>/COMPLETION.md has a References opened row that names at least one of the skill's reference files, by file name or stem (source-and-package-selection, component-code-patterns, parameterized-families, pin-file-generation, package-examples, verification-and-application). The label may carry a parenthetical and be followed by a colon or a table-cell bar. The row fails when its value on the label line is empty or starts with `none`: the verification row of the skill's routing table matches every task that reaches verification, so `none matched` is never right here. The value may wrap onto continuation lines indented deeper than the label line; a mention of the row inside prose does not count.

the component file sits under components/, optionally inside a namespace package and a category subdirectory, named texas_instruments_lm1117 followed by the orderable suffix. The suffix depends on the package and output-voltage answers the runner gets, so only the device stem is pinned; whether the MPN is a WSON orderable is the judges' call.
assertions.cmd: python3 -c "import re,sys;from pathlib import Path;o=Path(sys.argv[1]);h=[r for r in (p.relative_to(o).as_posix() for p in o.rglob('*.py')) if re.fullmatch(sys.argv[2],r,re.I)];sys.exit(0 if len(h)>=int(sys.argv[3]) else 'found '+str(len(h))+' file(s) matching '+sys.argv[2]+', need '+sys.argv[3])" <output> '([a-z0-9_]+/)?components/([a-z0-9_]+/)?texas_instruments_lm1117[a-z0-9_]*[.]py' 1

future_cases: Planned siblings in this lane: a non-standard package the generators cannot express, forcing the documented parts2jitx-kicad fallback with the reason recorded; and a >40-pin part where the correct answer is a partitioned multi-box symbol rather than one unreadable box.
